title: Upbeat Reel Music Default
tests: Checks whether the agent turns a vague music request into a usable upbeat audio bed using sensible defaults rather than blocking on optional preferences.

judge.summary: A 15-second audio file was delivered, but the supplied transcription does not establish its upbeat character, opening timing, or ending quality.

must_haves.item: One playable music audio file is delivered, not merely a description or song recommendation.
must_haves.why: A WAV audio file is supplied with a reported duration of 15 seconds and peak level of -1 dB.

must_haves.item: The music sounds upbeat, with a clear rhythmic pulse and lively energy.
must_haves.why: The audio cannot be heard here, and the transcription provides no reliable information about rhythm or energy.

must_haves.item: The opening establishes the music promptly without a long silent lead-in.
must_haves.why: Neither the transcription nor the duration and peak metadata establish when the music begins.

must_haves.item: The short excerpt is usable as a reel music bed, without audible glitches or an abrupt mid-note cutoff.
must_haves.why: The 15-second duration suits a short reel, but glitches and the ending cannot be assessed from the supplied information.
